raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#47328 added a 3-CTA-per-SM config for bf16 top-512 and switches to it when it needs fewer rounds than the 2-CTA config. It is built only for the page-transform path. The non-paged ragged calls, such as the DeepSeek-V4.1 prefill indexer top-k (thousands of rows, 64K-131K columns, per-row ends and offsets), never get it.

## Modifications

- `deep_select.py`: build the 3-CTA config for every bf16 top-512 module except `sorted_index`, instead of only for `page_transform`. The C++ rounds-based switch from #47328 then picks it whenever it needs fewer rounds.
- `test_deep_select.py`: `test_denser_tier_with_end_and_offset` runs the 3-CTA config without a page table, with ragged ends and per-row output offsets.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_deep_select.py` on sm_107 (CC 10.7) with the module-level skip forced off (`is_deep_select_supported()` does not list CC 10.7): 17 passed, including the new test.
- Benchmark inputs below: the selected index sets are identical to the parent's.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

sm_107 (CC 10.7), one GPU, bf16 logits, k = 512, ragged ends, 2 calls per CUDA graph, kineto median, time relative to the parent:

| rows x width | this PR vs parent |
|---|---|
| 8192 x 65536 | -19.6% |
| 4096 x 131072 | -10.4% |
| 256 x 65536 | 0.0% (unchanged config) |

DeepSeek-V4.1 prefill at 16K tokens per rank runs this top-k on 8192-row tiles. No end-to-end number is claimed. Only CC 10.7 was measured; the switch reads the SM count at runtime, so other GPUs take the 3-CTA config only where it needs fewer rounds.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit hooks.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation as needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (kernel level).

@@ -131,7 +131,7 @@ def _jit_deep_select_module(
     if cluster_size == 1:
         configs = _NORMAL_CONFIGS[(value_dtype, max_topk)]
         host_dispatch = "TopkNormal"
-        if page_transform and (value_dtype, max_topk) == (torch.bfloat16, 512):
+        if not sorted_index and (value_dtype, max_topk) == (torch.bfloat16, 512):
             configs = (*configs, _Config(512, 256, 3, 4096, 2048, 2))
     else:
         # Upstream tunes the cluster kernel for bf16 at max_topk 1024 alone, so

@@ -222,5 +222,25 @@ def test_page_transform_denser_tier():
     _check_topk(input, k, logical, idx_fill=-1)
 
 
+def test_denser_tier_with_end_and_offset():
+    """The same 3-CTA config without a page table: ragged ends and per-row offsets."""
+    rows = 2 * torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count + 1
+    k, width = 512, 33000
+    input = _make_input(rows, width, torch.bfloat16)
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(2)
+    end = torch.randint(
+        k, width + 1, (rows,), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda", generator=g
+    )
+    offset = torch.randint(
+        0, 1 << 20, (rows,), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda", generator=g
+    )
+
+    _, indices = topk(
+        input, k, end=end, output_idx_offset=offset, idx_oob_fill_value=-1
+    )
+
+    _check_topk(input, k, indices, end=end, idx_fill=-1, offset=offset)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
